title: Integral coefficient presentations and finite-label comparison data
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime and $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and chosen uniformizer $\pi_E$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Use the small pro-etale site of a scheme $X$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Define $\Lambda_E$ to be the commutative condensed ring with sections $C(S,\mathcal O_E)$ for the extending absolute-value topology [def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring]. Define $B_{E,X}$ to be the underlying abelian sheaf of the completed coefficient ring $\varprojlim_{n\ge1}(\mathcal O_E/\pi_E^n)_X$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Its ring-object structure is the one induced by that ring sheaf. For a finite set $T$ let $F_X(T)=T_X$ and $G_X(T)=h_{X[T]}$, naturally in $T$, using the profinite test objects $X[S]$ and point inverse image adjunction $p_X^*\dashv p_{X,*}$ of [sk-def-sfb-pullback-from-point]. Set $T_n=\mathcal O_E/\pi_E^{n+1}$ for $n\in\mathbf N$, with the specified reduction transitions, and regard $\mathcal O_E$ with its extending topology as a profinite set. Given a natural isomorphism $a:F_X\simeq G_X$, let $\rho_{a,n}$ denote its component at $T_n$, composed with the canonical constant-ring-to-constant-set identification. The pulled-back integral coefficient object is $p_X^*\Lambda_E$ with the transported ring structure [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients].
